name: Star College Scheme For Strengthening Of Science Education And Training At Undergraduate Level
benefit:

- One-time non-recurring grant of ₹10,00,000 per science department, recurring grant of ₹3,00,000 per science department per year for a period of three years, subject to satisfactory annual review, and ₹1,00,000, ₹2,00,000 and ₹3,00,000 subject to their departments for mentoring and monitoring per college and ₹1,00,000 per year under contingency head will be p
_eligibility_text:
> **For Colleges**

1. Minimum 4-5 UG courses in basic science such as botany, zoology, applied life science, microbiology, physiology/biochemistry, biotechnology etc. and 1-2 applied course/PG diploma courses.
1. Adequate in-house faculty expertise in each science department.
1. Independent laboratories for practicals to accommodate sanctioned student strength. 
1. Lecture halls/rooms for theory classes with minimum capacity for sanctioned student strength.
1. Basic infrastructure and facilities in laboratories and library, LCD / overhead projection facilities, Computers with internet access. 
1. To apply, the college must be Government or Government aided, autonomous included under Section 2(f)/12(B) of the UGC Act 1956. 
1. Colleges that have been not recommended for support can re-apply to DBT for financial support with appropriate modifications and revisions while those that get discontinued after a round of support are eligible for re-applying only after a cooling period of two years. 
1. The colleges who have already been supported under this scheme can apply for additional dept. after completion of one cycle i.e. 3 years of ongoing support.
